title: Client Management
subtitle: Manage clients, DPAs, and their secure compliance portals.
empty_state: No clients added yet. Click 'Add Client' to start managing agency clients.

dpa.title: Data Processing Agreement (DPA)
dpa.description: Manage the DPA between your agency (processor) and this client (controller). This is required under GDPR Article 28.

portal.title: Trust Portal
portal.description: Share a read-only compliance dashboard with this client showing their linked processing activities and vendors.
portal.regenerate_description: Every trust-portal link you have already shared with this client will stop working immediately. You will need to send them the new link.

activities.title: Linked Processing Activities
activities.description: Activities shown here appear on the client's compliance portal.
activities.empty: No processing activities linked to this client yet.
activities.unlink_description: It stops appearing on this client's trust portal. The activity itself stays in your ROPA.

link_modal.title: Link Processing Activities
link_modal.description: Select activities that involve this client's data.

vendors.title: Auto-generated Vendor List
vendors.description: When processing activities are linked, Custodia automatically traverses the data flow graph to determine which of your vendors sub-process data for this client.
vendors.note: (Vendor graph resolution requires full ROPA data population)

report.title: Client Compliance Report
report.description: Generate a formal PDF report detailing your processing activities and sub-processor DPAs scoped specifically to {name}. Send this when clients ask for your GDPR compliance posture.

preview.disabled: Enable the portal in the Overview tab to view the preview.
preview.description: This is an interactive preview of exactly what {name} sees at their secure link.

controller.title: Controller identity
controller.subtitle: What Article 30(2)(a) requires this record to say about the controller you act for. It appears in the client's Article 30(2) record exactly as entered here.
controller.legal_name_hint: The registered name, not the trading name — this is what a supervisory authority matches against.
controller.representative_hint: Required where the controller is not established in the Union.
controller.dpo_hint: The client's own DPO. Leaving it blank prints “None designated”, which is a statement rather than a gap.
controller.processing_categories: Categories of processing carried out for this controller
controller.processing_categories_hint: Article 30(2)(b). Comma separated. A property of the relationship, not of one activity.
controller.save_failed: The controller identity could not be saved.
